verdict.rationale: Helicone doesn't document explicit cloud region/residency selection, but it does offer self-hosting deployment options (Docker Compose, multiple deployment methods) that let a user control where their data physically resides. This is an indirect, DIY path rather than a first-class region-selection feature in the hosted product. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selector in the hosted SaaS offering, documentation of EU/US data centers, or compliance certifications tied to specific storage locations.
